sources.title: ATO: Tax invoices, including eInvoicing and recipient-created tax invoices
sources.fact: Read 24 September 2026 (page last updated 18 September 2026). Lists tax invoice requirements by value band, accepts a compliant Peppol eInvoice as intended to be a tax invoice, sets RCTI issue conditions and issuer checks. No figure is adopted into the skill.
sources.limitations: Verify the complete document, applicable period and current status at use time.
